basePrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver exactly ONE high-fidelity desktop application UI screenshot concept, landscape 1536x1024. Fill entire image with one macOS ssterm desktop window, front-on pixel-perfect, no perspective, no poster, no explanatory outside captions, no multiple frames. This is a complete UI redesign reference for existing ssterm workflows.
Reference 1 is the approved Charcoal v2 brand board: use its flat neutral-charcoal palette and existing SST logo identity. Reference 2 is the original official SST monogram and lowercase ssterm wordmark, preserve the existing silhouette faithfully. If a third image is supplied it is the master Servers screen: match its title bar, sidebar, layout geometry, typography and spacing closely.
Visual system: main canvas #1E1E1E, sidebar #202020, raised surfaces #252525, fields #292929, dividers #383838, primary text #F3F3F3, secondary #A3A3A3. Electric blue #2563EB for primary button, focus ring, active navigation and tabs. Cyan belongs to the original logo. Green/amber/red only for operational status, always with readable word and icon. Neutral gray surfaces dominate, no navy cast, no purple, no decorative gradient wash, no neon glow or glassmorphism. Inter UI typography, JetBrains Mono terminal/code, precise restrained thin-stroke Lucide-style icons, professional technical desktop app. Modest 8px control corners, compact 36px controls, 4/8px spacing rhythm, generous 24-32px content padding.
Stable app shell: macOS traffic-light controls top left in a 48px title bar, subtle top border. Left sidebar approximately 224px wide. At its top original small SST icon and lowercase ssterm. Navigation exactly: Servers, Terminals, Files, Identities, Known hosts, Snippets, Port forwarding, Recordings, Team vault. Bottom Settings and Lock workspace. Short group tree under main navigation only when relevant: All servers, Development, Staging, Production. Do not add cloud-account-required banners or unrelated features.
All entity forms and in-app overlay forms MUST be RIGHT-EDGE DRAWERS: attached to the actual extreme right edge of the window, full usable height below title bar, flat #252525, approximately 480-560px wide, vertical left divider, title and close X fixed at top, scrollable middle, sticky action footer at bottom. For complex settings 640px width is allowed. The parent screen remains identifiable behind a subtle dark scrim; no heavy blur. No centered modal form, no floating form card, no gap to right edge, no stacked drawers. Confirmation steps replace the current drawer body, not a second centered popup. A static image shows the fully open endpoint of a slide from right; do not draw motion arrows.
Use short readable English UI labels. Only invented nonsecret demo hosts such as web-dev-01 and 192.0.2.10, usernames dev, .example endpoints. Password and passphrase fields EMPTY with placeholders, no actual credentials, tokens, private keys, long invented crypto keys or secrets. Never show private key material. Keep actual target user@host:port visible, PROD explicitly labeled. Connected status distinct from selected blue navigation. No AI assistant, no unimplemented Mosh/FIDO/mobile/remote-to-remote/resume functions. Avoid charts/metrics invented for SSH software.

Six demo rows web-dev-01 192.0.2.10 dev-key DEV Connected; api-dev-02 192.0.2.11 dev-key DEV Disconnected; staging-01 192.0.2.20 ops-key STAGING Connecting; prod-web-01 192.0.2.30 prod-ops PROD Disconnected; prod-db-01 192.0.2.31 prod-ops PROD Disconnected; build-lab 192.0.2.40 dev-key DEV Error. Blue selected first row with separate green Connected text. Discreet Connect button per row. Bottom status Local workspace / 6 servers / 1 connected. Large realistic data table, not marketing cards.

screens.title: Terminals · SSH tabs and splits
screens.content: Full SSH terminal workspace no drawer. Top tab strip web-dev-01 connected green dot and blue active underline; staging-01 connecting amber dot; prod-web-01 green Connected but INACTIVE gray tab with explicit PROD badge, demonstrating focus/status distinction. Toolbar New local terminal, Split right, Split down, Workspace tools. Main area two side-by-side terminal panes, each has context bar dev@192.0.2.10:22 DEV and ops@192.0.2.30:22 PROD. Left focused pane thin blue outline, displays harmless pwd and ls output. Right production pane displays uptime output, no destructive command. Bottom session status Connected / UTF-8, font in JetBrains Mono. Crisp terminal-first app, minimal chrome.

screens.title: Terminals · local shell
screens.content: Terminals page no drawer, active tab Local · zsh with small laptop icon, second inactive SSH web-dev-01. Terminal context bar Local / This Mac / zsh, no host endpoint pretending to be SSH. Terminal shows demo@mac ~ % pwd and /Users/demo and demo@mac ~ % ls with projects and notes. Top actions New local terminal, Split right, Restart. A subtle bottom label Local process · UTF-8. No SFTP/jump/broadcast controls for this local pane. Large quiet charcoal terminal surface.

screens.title: Terminal · captured Paste/Run target
screens.content: Terminal parent with web-dev-01 active, RIGHT drawer Prepare snippet. Captured target box ops@192.0.2.30:22 PROD, prominent independent from background focus. Snippet selector Check disk, editable monospaced code textarea 'df -h'. Plain explanation Paste inserts into the composer. Run sends the command with Enter. Button row Paste and Run as distinct actions; Show PROD confirmation phase in lower drawer body: Review target / confirm checkbox unchecked, Confirm Run disabled until acknowledged. Footer Cancel. Helper Sending bytes does not confirm command success. No implication background tab focus changes captured target.

screens.title: Connection · transient auth
screens.content: Terminal connecting parent, RIGHT drawer SSH authentication. Target dev@192.0.2.10:22, section Password, empty protected input placeholder Enter password; second visual challenge section small collapsed Keyboard-interactive challenge alternative, no actual secret. Subtitle Attempt 1 of 3. Neutral note Used only for this connection. No save-password default or Google sign in for SSH. Footer Cancel connection outline and Continue blue. screens.title: Files · SFTP and transfer queue
screens.content: Files page no drawer. Heading Files with saved server selector web-dev-01 and Connected green. Two well-balanced panes, left Local /Users/demo/projects, right Remote dev@192.0.2.10:22 /home/dev/app. Each has back/up/refresh, path bar and file table Name Size Modified. screens.title: Transfers · overwrite/skip/rename
screens.content: Files dual-pane parent, RIGHT drawer File already exists, subtitle Upload to dev@192.0.2.10:22. File app.conf. Compare Source local 2.4 KB and Destination remote 2.1 KB with paths. Three large radio rows Skip / Rename / Overwrite, Rename selected. Rename field app-copy.conf. Subtle note Retry starts from byte zero; interrupted partial files may remain. Footer Cancel transfer outline and Continue blue. Overwrite is an explicit choice, never preselected. Queue remains visible behind.

screens.title: Files · external edit lifecycle
screens.content: Files parent, RIGHT drawer Remote edit for /home/dev/app/app.conf on dev@192.0.2.10:22. A vertical three-step status Download snapshot completed / Open in TextEdit pending / Upload reviewed snapshot pending. Explain A private plaintext working copy is stored on this Mac while editing. Clearly separate actions Open in TextEdit outline and Upload snapshot blue; Finish and Discard tertiary. Visible consent checkbox I agree to open a local working copy, unchecked. Helper Remote file is checked before upload; other writes can still race. Do NOT draw an integrated in-app code editor or claim atomic save. Footer Close. No user plaintext document displayed.

screens.title: Snippets · encrypted library
